title: Eannatum
summary: Ruler listed in CFAH-15 Table 5 (Lagash I dynasty).
description: Ruler of Lagash I dynasty. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-15 (Table 5, "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Lagash I"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Reign (y): ~25; Start (BC): ~1751; End (BC): ~1726). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 5 "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Lagash I", p. 54
